sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game features a variety of targets, including normal ducks, ducks with a crown, and even monsters. One of the key aspects of the game is the penalty system. When a player hits a wrong duck, they incur a penalty that reduces their points. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, as players must navigate the targets carefully to avoid hitting the wrong ones.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can be earned by completing levels or achieving certain milestones. These power-ups can give players a temporary advantage, such as increased points or invincibility, making it easier to complete levels and achieve high scores.
